description: agent.rows refused as a shape error because it was asked to sort by a name it has never published (PG4). The seven sorts are a closed vocabulary — the wire words the store's own bounds map turns into column literals — so an unknown one is refused BEFORE any query runs, naming what the caller sent and listing what exists. The order by is never built from a caller's string: a sort that reached SQL text would be a caller writing the query, and the refusal is the same −32602 voice the daemon uses for every other "that is not one of the values". A typo here costs one round trip; a silently ignored one costs a table that looks sorted while it is not.

error.message: invalid params: sort "colour" is not one of the sorts this read answers — "createdAt", "internal", "name", "signed", "slug", "updatedAt", "version"
